name: Access Level Audit
summary: Counts Swift declarations by access level (public, open, internal, private, fileprivate; default internal when unspecified) and lists the files with the most public API. Heuristic: access is inferred from keywords on the declaration line, with public/open taking precedence over private(set).

name: Accessibility Audit
summary: Heuristic SwiftUI accessibility audit: flags Button/Image without accessibility labels, TextField with empty labels, and color-only state.

name: Accessibility Audit Scanner
summary: Audits SwiftUI views for missing accessibility labels, hints, and VoiceOver tap targets.

name: API Docs Coverage
summary: Measures the share of public/open Swift declarations that carry documentation comments.

name: API Endpoint Audit
summary: Inventories hardcoded http(s) URL literals in Swift sources, grouped by host — surfacing endpoints that should be configurable.

name: API Surface
summary: Extracts public/open declarations (func, class, struct, enum, protocol, actor, var, let, typealias, extension) from Swift files, grouped by file, with file:line locations and a total count.

name: Compile Artboard Preview
summary: Triggers compilation and preview generation of a custom artboard or the active SwiftUI file.

name: Create Artboard
summary: Creates a new artboard in the Visual UI Builder with custom SwiftUI code or standard component layout.

name: Delete Artboard
summary: Deletes an artboard from the Visual UI Builder canvas by identifier or name.

name: Get Artboard Details
summary: Retrieves full configuration, component tree hierarchy, and custom SwiftUI source code for a specified artboard.

name: List Artboards
summary: Lists all artboards in the active Visual UI Builder workspace, including IDs, device frames, appearance, and component counts.

name: Run Full App
summary: Builds the active project and runs it directly inside an iOS/macOS simulator, reporting logs and execution status.

name: Update Artboard
summary: Updates an existing artboard's source code, device frame, appearance, or properties.

name: List Asset Catalog
summary: Lists asset catalogs under the workspace and the image, color, and app-icon sets inside each catalog.

name: Asset Catalog Manager
summary: Inspects, manages, and creates asset catalogs (.xcassets), image sets, color sets, and dataset assets.

name: Add Asset Image
summary: Adds an image to an asset catalog by creating an .imageset with Contents.json and copying the source image.

name: Automated Repair Engine
summary: Consumes compiler diagnostics, applies targeted fixes, and validates by rebuilding.

name: Autonomous Review Engine
summary: Performs static self-review, detects inefficient patterns, and proposes refactors.

name: Batch Rename Files
summary: Renames multiple files in a directory matching a prefix, suffix, or substring pattern.

name: Binary Plist Converter
summary: Converts property list files between XML and Binary formats using plutil.

name: Binary Size Report
summary: Reports total size and the 10 largest files for each .app bundle under the workspace build directory or an explicit in-workspace path. DerivedData is never scanned.

name: Build Configuration List
summary: Lists build configurations (Debug/Release/custom) for the project and each target from the .pbxproj.

name: Build Log Analyze
summary: Parses an xcodebuild/swift-build log file: extracts errors, warnings, build result, and timing summary.

name: Build Phase Scripts List
summary: Lists Run Script build phases from the .pbxproj with their names and script bodies (truncated).

name: Build Settings Diff
summary: Diffs two .xcconfig files key-by-key, reporting added, removed, and changed build settings.

name: Build System Detect
summary: Detects the build systems in use: .xcworkspace/.xcodeproj, SwiftPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, Tuist, xcodegen, Bazel, CMake.

name: Bundle Resource Auditor
summary: Audits project resources, asset catalogs, and bundle copy phases for missing or orphaned assets.

name: Call Hierarchy
summary: For a function name, finds its definition site, its callers across the workspace, and the functions it calls.

name: Carthage Cartfile Inspector
summary: Inspects Carthage dependencies and resolved versions in Cartfile and Cartfile.resolved.

name: Change Impact Estimate
summary: Estimates the blast radius of changing a file: finds Swift files that reference its base symbol name.

name: Clipboard Manager
summary: Reads text from or copies content to the macOS system clipboard (NSPasteboard).

name: Code Comment Extract
summary: Extracts documentation comments (/// and /** */) for a symbol or a whole file, with locations.

name: Format Code
summary: Formats the code according to project style guidelines.

name: Generate File
summary: Generates a new file with boilerplate or specific logic.

name: Insert Code Block
summary: Inserts a block of code at a specific line or before/after a symbol.

name: Lint Code
summary: Runs a linter on the specified file or directory.

name: Code Metrics Analyzer
summary: Calculates lines of code, comment density, type counts, and complexity metrics for Swift source files.

name: Multi-file Edit
summary: Applies edits across multiple files simultaneously.

name: Controlled Mutation Engine
summary: Applies safe, minimal source mutations scoped to a symbol or an exact range.

name: Refactor
summary: Performs code refactoring (e.g., extract method, rename variable) intelligently.

name: Replace in File
summary: Replaces a specific targeted code snippet within an existing file, ensuring exact match and providing unified diffs.

name: Code Review Validation
summary: Validates the completed implementation using an independent AI reviewer stage before finishing the task.

name: Code Signing Diagnose
summary: Diagnoses code-signing state of a built .app/.framework: signature validity, authority chain, team identifier, and hardened-runtime flags.

name: Code Snippet & Architecture Template Manager
summary: Retrieves and injects battle-tested Swift architecture templates (SwiftUI MVVM, AsyncStream, Actor isolation, Keychain wrapper).

name: Code Summary
summary: Provides a high-level summary of a file or directory.

name: Color Usage Audit
summary: Finds hardcoded colors in SwiftUI/UIKit code (Color(red:), UIColor literals, hex strings) that should live in the asset catalog.

name: Color Set Builder
summary: Creates or updates adaptive Light/Dark mode colorsets in Xcode asset catalogs.

name: Comment Density Report
summary: Reports comment-to-code ratios per Swift file, flagging the least-documented files.

name: Compiler Diagnostics Engine
summary: Runs xcodebuild and parses warnings/errors into structured diagnostics.

name: Complexity Analysis
summary: Analyzes the cyclomatic complexity of code.

name: Concurrency Audit
summary: Heuristic scan for Swift concurrency hazards: DispatchQueue.main.sync, nonisolated(unsafe), mutable static vars, Task blocks without await, force unwraps inside async functions, and SwiftUI types without @MainActor. All findings are heuristic leads, not confirmed bugs.

name: Conflict Marker Scan
summary: Scans source files for unresolved merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>).

name: Persistent Context Store
summary: Stores and retrieves persistent key-value context across Assist sessions.

name: Conversation Context Manager
summary: Reads, updates, or checks the active conversation's dedicated context file (<conversation_id>.context.md).

name: Core Data Model Inspector
summary: Locates, inspects, and parses Core Data .xcdatamodeld schemas, entities, attributes, and relationships.

name: Count File Lines and Code Metrics
summary: Calculates total lines, code lines, comment lines, and blank lines across workspace files.

name: Crash Log Parse
summary: Parses .crash/.ips crash logs: exception type, termination reason, faulting thread, and top blamed frames.

name: Create Artifact
summary: Creates (or updates/appends) a Markdown artifact in the native artifact store at .assist_temp/artifacts/<name>.md. The single way to produce durable deliverables. Optional kind parameter: \\

name: create_new_app
summary: Creates a new native application project from user specifications or autonomous request parameters.

name: Convert CSV to JSON
summary: Parses a tabular CSV file and converts records into a structured JSON array of objects.

name: Dead Code Eliminator
summary: Identifies unreferenced private functions, unused variables, and unreachable code structures in Swift files.

name: Dead Code Scan
summary: Heuristic scan for Swift declarations that appear to have no references outside their own declaration line. Excludes public/open API, @main entry points, overrides, and well-known lifecycle names. Findings are heuristic leads, not proof of dead code.

name: Delete Artifact
summary: Permanently deletes a Markdown artifact from the native artifact store. agent_notes.md is protected and cannot be deleted.

name: Dependency Graph
summary: Generates a graph of project dependencies.

name: Dependency Licenses
summary: Inventories third-party dependencies from Package.resolved and Podfile.lock, reporting versions for license review.

name: Dependency Resolution Engine
summary: Resolves the workspace project's existing Swift Package dependencies via xcodebuild.

name: Deprecation Usage Scan
summary: Finds declarations marked @available(*, deprecated) in workspace Swift sources and reports where those deprecated symbols are used.

name: DerivedData Locate
summary: Locates the project's DerivedData directories under ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData with sizes.

name: List Devices
summary: Lists connected Apple devices via devicectl, falling back to xctrace. Fails clearly when no devices are found or the tooling is unavailable.

name: Change Directory
summary: Changes the session working directory (native cd equivalent). Subsequent plain relative paths resolve against it; use_terminal defaults to it when workingDirectory is omitted. Validates existence, directory-ness, and workspace containment.

name: Create Directory
summary: Creates a new directory at the specified path.

name: Delete Directory
summary: Deletes a directory and all its contents.

name: Print Working Directory
summary: Reports the session working directory (native pwd equivalent).

name: Read Directory
summary: Lists the contents of a directory (native ls equivalent). Returns sorted entries with directory markers, entry count, and the resolved path. Non-recursive — use tree_view for a recursive listing.

name: Directory Size Report
summary: Reports recursive disk usage per immediate subdirectory of a directory, largest first.

name: Disk Space Analyzer
summary: Calculates disk consumption across DerivedData, project build outputs, and caches.

name: Build DocC Docs
summary: Builds DocC documentation with xcodebuild docbuild and verifies a .doccarchive was produced.

name: Generate Docs
summary: Generates a markdown API document from public Swift declarations in the workspace. Refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true.

name: Docs Index Build
summary: Builds an index of all Markdown files in the workspace: path, title (first heading), and size.

name: DocC Documentation Generator
summary: Generates Apple DocC compliant documentation comments (///) with Parameters, Returns, and Throws tags for Swift declarations.

name: Duplicate Code Scan
summary: Heuristic scan for duplicated blocks of Swift code. Lines are normalized (trimmed, blank lines and full-line comments and brace-only lines skipped) and compared with a sliding window. Findings are heuristic leads — duplicated blocks may be intentional.

name: Find Empty Directories
summary: Finds empty directories under a path — candidates for cleanup.

name: Entitlements Diff
summary: Compares two .entitlements plist files, reporting added, removed, and changed keys.

name: Entitlements Manager
summary: Inspects, adds, and removes Apple security entitlements (.entitlements) like App Sandbox and Network access.

name: Discover Entry Points
summary: Finds application entry points: @main types, main.swift, and AppDelegate/SceneDelegate classes.

name: Capture Logs
summary: Captures logs from the execution environment.

name: Environment Info
summary: Provides information about the runtime environment (OS, Swift version, etc.).

name: Environment Variable Manager
summary: Inspects, checks, or updates workspace .env configuration files and environment keys.

name: Executable Files Scan
summary: Lists files with the executable bit set under a directory — a hygiene check for accidental +x bits in repos.

name: External Resource Gateway
summary: Fetches external APIs and returns structured JSON response data.

name: Extract Code Symbols
summary: Extracts top-level declarations (class, struct, enum, protocol, actor, func, extension) and signatures from a source file.

name: Fetch Apple Documentation
summary: Retrieves real Apple Developer documentation: API references (Swift/ObjC), framework guides, declarations, availability, and code examples from official Apple sources.

name: Append to File
summary: Appends content to the end of a file.

name: File Backup
summary: Backs up a workspace file to .assist_temp/backups/<name>.<timestamp>.bak before a risky edit.

name: File Checksum Verifier
summary: Computes and verifies SHA-256, SHA-1, or MD5 cryptographic hashes for workspace files.

name: Compare Two Files and Generate Diff
summary: Compares two files line-by-line and produces a formatted unified diff with added/removed stats.

name: Copy File
summary: Copies a file from source to destination path.

name: Create File
summary: Creates a new file with full content and intermediate directories when needed.

name: Delete File
summary: Deletes a file at the specified path.

name: Verify File Hash
summary: Computes a file hash with shasum or md5 and compares it to an expected hash. A mismatch is reported as a successful comparison with match false, not as a tool error.

name: File Head Preview
summary: Previews the first N lines of a file with encoding detection. Never dumps whole files.

name: File Metadata
summary: Returns size, dates, permissions, type, and directory status for a file or directory inside the workspace.

name: Move File
summary: Moves a file from source to destination path.

name: Read File
summary: Reads the content of a file at the specified path. Pass lines {start,end} for a 1-based inclusive line range; omit lines to read the whole file.

name: Rename File
summary: Renames a file at the specified path.

name: File Type Breakdown
summary: Breaks down a directory by file extension: file counts and total bytes per type.

name: Write File
summary: Writes or overwrites a file with the specified content, generating unified diffs.

name: Find Duplicate Files
summary: Finds byte-identical duplicate files under a directory using SHA-256 content hashing.

name: Fix Artboards and Visual UI Builder Errors
summary: Audits the entire Artboards, Visual UI Builder, and Preview subsystem, diagnoses simulator, destination, code signing, and syntax errors, and applies automated repairs until compilation succeeds.

name: Force Unwrap Scan
summary: Scans Swift sources for force unwraps (!), try!, and as! — crash-prone constructs worth reviewing.

name: Format and Validate JSON File
summary: Validates and pretty-prints a JSON file with consistent indentation and sorted keys.

name: Framework Linker Auditor
summary: Inspects PBXFrameworksBuildPhase in Xcode projects to audit linked system and dynamic frameworks.

name: Function Size Report
summary: Finds the longest functions by line count, highlighting decomposition candidates.

name: Generate File Cryptographic Checksum
summary: Computes SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, and MD5 cryptographic checksums of a file on disk.

name: Generate Xcode Project
summary: Generates .xcodeproj files from an XcodeGen project.yml spec. Installs XcodeGen automatically if missing. Runs in the background without a terminal approval prompt.

name: Git Bisect
summary: Runs one step of git bisect (start, good, bad, skip, reset, or log) in the workspace repository.

name: Git Blame Inspector
summary: Inspects author, commit hash, date, and commit message for specific lines in a workspace file.

name: Compare Branches
summary: Compares two branches with diff stat plus the commits in head not in base.

name: Git Branch Manager
summary: Inspects, lists, creates, switches, and manages Git branches in the workspace.

name: Git Cherry-Pick
summary: Cherry-picks one commit onto the current branch. On conflict it reports the conflicted files and leaves the state for manual resolution.

name: Git Conflict Resolver
summary: Detects, inspects, and helps resolve Git merge conflict markers in workspace source files.

name: Git Log Viewer
summary: Retrieves structured commit history, commit hashes, dates, authors, and changed file stats.

name: PR Summary
summary: Builds a local markdown PR summary (commits, files changed, insertions/deletions) for head versus base using only local git history. No network, no GitHub API.

name: Git Stash Operator
summary: Manages Git stashes (save, pop, list, show, drop) to safely stash and restore changes during refactoring.

name: GitHub Repository Inspector
summary: Reads real GitHub repositories: metadata, file trees, directory listings, source file contents, code search, and bounded full-repository retrieval. Public repos need no login; private repos use the user's saved GitHub credential.

name: Gzip Compress File
summary: Compresses a file into a .gz file using system gzip.

name: Gzip Decompress File
summary: Decompresses a .gz file into a destination file using system gzip.

name: App Icon Generator & Validator
summary: Validates, configures, or scaffolds complete AppIcon.appiconset specifications in asset catalogs.

name: Image Asset Size Report
summary: Reports oversized image files inside .xcassets catalogs — candidates for compression or vectorization.

name: Convert Image Format
summary: Converts an image file between formats (png, jpeg, tiff, bmp, gif) with optional compression quality.

name: Decode Base64 to Image
summary: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into an image file (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, GIF) and saves it to disk.

name: Encode Image to Base64
summary: Reads an image file from the workspace and encodes it into a Base64 string or Data URI.

name: Extract Image Metadata
summary: Extracts all embedded EXIF, TIFF, GPS, and camera metadata from an image as structured JSON.

name: Generate Image Thumbnail
summary: Generates a scaled thumbnail image maintaining aspect ratio and writes it to disk.

name: Get Image Dimensions and Specs
summary: Extracts image dimensions (width, height), scale, color space, and format without loading full bitmap.

name: Import Cleanup
summary: Removes unused import lines from Swift files. An import is removed only when its module name never appears as a whole word anywhere else in the file. Well-known Apple SDK and test modules (Foundation, SwiftUI, XCTest, Testing, and others) are never removed, because their symbols do not mention the module name. Only files that change are rewritten. Heuristic: it does not resolve re-exports or typealiases across modules.

name: Import Graph
summary: Builds a file-level import graph: which modules each source file imports, and which files import a given module.

name: Info.plist Audit
summary: Audits Info.plist files for required keys, version-format sanity, and duplicate bundle identifiers.

name: Auto-Fix Errors
summary: Attempts to automatically fix detected compilation or linting errors.

name: Breakdown Task
summary: Breaks down a plan into granular, actionable steps.

name: Explain Code
summary: Provides a detailed explanation of the code at a path.

name: Generate Tests
summary: Generates unit test stubs for Swift types with proper setup and teardown.

name: Plan Task
summary: Generates a high-level execution plan for a complex task.

name: Interface Simulator & Accessibility Auditor
summary: Inspects SwiftUI View files, audits accessibility traits, accessibility identifiers, touch targets, and hierarchy structure.

name: Convert JSON to CSV
summary: Converts a JSON array of objects into a standard CSV tabular file.

name: Convert JSON to Plist
summary: Converts a JSON file into an Apple Property List (.plist, XML or Binary format).

name: Validate JSON
summary: Validates a JSON file, and optionally formats it as pretty-printed sorted-keys JSON, writing the result back only when write is true.

name: JSON Validator & Formatter
summary: Validates JSON syntax, highlights line errors, and beautifies JSON configuration files.

name: License Header Check
summary: Checks the first 15 lines of each Swift file for required header text (default: \\

name: List Artifacts
summary: Lists all Markdown artifacts in the native artifact store, including agent_notes.md, newest first.

name: Localization Audit
summary: Compares localization keys across locales and reports missing keys and keys never referenced in Swift code.

name: Localization Manager
summary: Inspects, extracts, adds translations, and validates .strings, .stringsdict, and .xcstrings localization files.

name: App Localizer
summary: Fully localizes an app into up to 3 languages per session: discovers localizable strings in Swift sources, creates/merges a Localizable.xcstrings String Catalog with translations, and sets Info.plist CFBundleLocalizations + CFBundleDevelopmentRegion. Follows the LocalizingApps.md System Asset.

name: Mach-O Binary Analyzer
summary: Inspects built application binaries, architectures (arm64, x86_64), and linked dynamic libraries via otool and file.

name: Manage Memory
summary: Allows Assist to edit, delete, or reorganize memories in UserMemory.md.

name: Markdown Link Check
summary: Validates links in Markdown files: internal file links must resolve; reports broken ones.

name: Markdown TOC Generate
summary: Generates a table of contents from a Markdown file's headings and inserts or updates it between TOC markers.

name: Clear Memory
summary: Clears all stored information in the memory graph.

name: Context Snapshot
summary: Captures a snapshot of the current environment and open files for future reference.

name: Retrieve Memory
summary: Retrieves information from the long-term memory graph.

name: Store Memory
summary: Stores information in the long-term memory graph.

name: Memory Leak Detector
summary: Scans Swift source code for retain cycles, strong self capture in escaping closures, and unowned reference risks.

name: Network Security & ATS Auditor
summary: Audits NSAppTransportSecurity in Info.plist for insecure HTTP and ATS exceptions.

name: Open in Finder
summary: Opens a file or directory in Finder or its default application.

name: Add Package Dependency
summary: Inserts a .package(url:from:) entry into the dependencies array in Package.swift.

name: Audit Package Dependencies
summary: Audits Swift package dependencies from Package.swift and Package.resolved, flagging missing pins and unpinned requirements.

name: Update Package Dependencies
summary: Runs swift package update in the workspace root to update Swift package dependencies.

name: Read Package Manifest
summary: Reads Package.swift and summarizes the package name, platforms, products, targets, and dependencies.

name: Validate Package Manifest
summary: Validates Package.swift by running swift package dump-package and reporting the package name and target count.

name: Patch Application Engine
summary: Generates and applies line-level patches with integrity validation.

name: pbxproj Lint
summary: Lints the .pbxproj: file references pointing at missing files, duplicate paths, and build files with dangling file references.

name: Performance Benchmark
summary: Runs an allow-listed command N times via Process and reports average, minimum, and maximum wall time plus exit codes.

name: Permissions Audit
summary: Audits Info.plist usage descriptions, entitlements, and PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy entries, and flags API usage missing a usage description.

name: Edit Plist
summary: Gets, sets, or deletes a key in a plist file using PropertyListSerialization.

name: Property List Editor
summary: Inspects, sets, deletes, and validates keys in Apple Property List (.plist) files.

name: Convert Plist to JSON
summary: Converts an Apple Property List (.plist) file directly into formatted JSON format.

name: Podfile & CocoaPods Inspector
summary: Inspects CocoaPods dependencies, versions, and target configurations in Podfile and Podfile.lock.

name: Preflight Checks
summary: Runs environment preflight checks before a build/task: workspace writable, Xcode tools present, DerivedData reachable, free disk space.

name: Privacy Manifest Auditor
summary: Audits or scaffolds Apple Privacy Manifests (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) for Required Reason API compliance.

name: Process Monitor
summary: Monitors active build, compiler, simulator, and child processes on macOS.

name: Archive Project
summary: Archives the user's Xcode project with xcodebuild archive and verifies the .xcarchive exists.

name: Build Project
summary: Builds the user's Xcode project with xcodebuild, executed directly in the background without requiring terminal approval.

name: Build Settings
summary: Reads Xcode build settings with xcodebuild, or sets one build setting key in the project's pbxproj.

name: Capabilities
summary: Lists app capabilities from entitlements and pbxproj, or enables/disables one capability by editing the entitlements plist.

name: View Changelog
summary: Displays the history of project snapshots and changes.

name: Clean Project
summary: Cleans the project: removes the workspace build directory and/or runs xcodebuild clean. Requires explicit confirmation.

name: Diff Project
summary: Compares the working tree with Git HEAD, returning real unified diffs and modified files.

name: Entitlements
summary: Finds and parses .entitlements files in the workspace and returns their keys and values.

name: Info.plist Editor
summary: Reads and edits Info.plist keys using PropertyListSerialization with atomic writes and verification.

name: Xcode Project Mutation Controller
summary: Adds/removes file references in the user's project.pbxproj, resolving groups and build phases from the target project.

name: Restore Snapshot
summary: Restores the project to a previously saved state.

name: List Schemes
summary: Lists the Xcode schemes available for the user's project or workspace.

name: Signing Check
summary: Checks code-signing build settings and lists installed provisioning profile filenames without parsing profile contents.

name: Snapshot Project
summary: Creates a full snapshot of the current project state.

name: Project Structure Map
summary: Builds a machine-readable map of the project: top-level directories with file counts and the Xcode target layout parsed from the .pbxproj when present.

name: Add Target
summary: Adds a new Xcode target: creates a source directory with a real Swift file and inserts PBXNativeTarget blocks into project.pbxproj.

name: List Targets
summary: Lists the Xcode targets in the user's project by scanning project.pbxproj and xcodebuild output.

name: Run Tests
summary: Executes test suites and test plans using xcodebuild test with proper platform targeting.

name: Protocol Conformance List
summary: Lists every type that declares conformance to a given protocol, with declaration locations.

name: Provisioning Check
summary: Lists installed provisioning profiles, reports expiration, and compares App IDs against an optional bundle ID.

name: Provisioning Profile Reader
summary: Decodes and inspects entitlements, team ID, and expiration date of Apple provisioning profiles.

name: Read Artifact
summary: Reads a Markdown artifact's full content from the native artifact store (truncated at 60k characters).

name: README Generate
summary: Generates a README.md skeleton from real repository inspection: project name, build systems, targets, structure, and entry points.

name: Locate README
summary: Finds README files in the workspace (any case/extension), reporting each path and its title line.

name: Recent Changes
summary: Lists workspace files modified within the last N hours, newest first. Catches local edits regardless of git state.

name: Regex Replace in Files
summary: Performs regular expression search and replace across multiple workspace files with dry-run support.

name: Repository Overview
summary: Summarizes the workspace repository: file counts by language, directory breadth, README/license presence, and largest files.

name: Reveal in Finder
summary: Reveals and selects a file or directory in macOS Finder.

name: Runtime Diagnostics Engine
summary: Analyzes runtime logs for crashes/anomalies and suggests concrete fixes.

name: Undo Last Action
summary: Reverts the last modification made by the agent.

name: Validate Changes
summary: Verifies that the applied changes are correct and don't break functionality.

name: Save to Memory
summary: Saves high-value architectural decisions, preferences, guidelines, and context to UserMemory.md.

name: Scheme Test Plan List
summary: Finds .xctestplan files in the workspace and lists the test targets each plan covers.

name: Regex Search
summary: Searches for a regular expression pattern within the project files.

name: Search Agent Skills
summary: Search SwiftCode's authoritative local skills library for specialized domain guides, architectures, workflows, and best practices. Call this tool when an objective involves a specific technology, framework, pattern, or task category.

name: Symbol Search
summary: Searches for symbols (classes, methods, variables) within the project.

name: Search Text
summary: Searches for text across files in the project sandbox.

name: Secrets Scan
summary: Scans source and config files for secret patterns. Reports file:line:pattern only and never outputs matched secret values.

name: Security Audit Scanner
summary: Scans Swift source files for hardcoded secrets, API keys, insecure HTTP endpoints, and unsafe storage practices.

name: Semantic Source Query Engine
summary: Performs semantic search for symbols, SwiftUI views, models, and services with usage context.

name: Export Session
summary: Writes a markdown export with session metadata (title, timestamp, session ID, workspace, notes). Does not read conversation history. Refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true.

name: Session Progress Report
summary: Summarizes the active agent session: engineering phases by status, failures, and the last agent-notes save time.

name: Code Signing Certificate Inspector
summary: Inspects valid Apple Development and Distribution code signing certificates in the keychain.

name: Boot Simulator
summary: Boots or shuts down a simulator by UDID via simctl, then verifies the resulting state.

name: Simulator Controller
summary: Controls Apple platform simulators (boot, shutdown, install app, open URL) via simctl.

name: List Simulators
summary: Lists available iOS/tvOS/watchOS simulators with runtime, state, and UDID via simctl.

name: Source Graph Builder
summary: Parses Swift files and returns dependency and symbol relationship graph data.

name: SPM Dependency Tree
summary: Parses Package.resolved and Package.swift to construct the complete resolved dependency tree.

name: Stale Files Report
summary: Reports source files not modified in a long time, surfacing potentially abandoned or legacy code.

name: String Catalog Migrator
summary: Converts legacy .strings files into modern Xcode 15+ String Catalogs (.xcstrings).

name: String Literal Audit
summary: Finds hardcoded user-facing string literals that are not routed through localization (NSLocalizedString / String(localized:)).

name: Strings File Validate
summary: Validates .strings localization files: syntax errors, duplicate keys, and empty values.

name: Localization Strings
summary: Gets, sets, or deletes a localization string in Localizable.strings or Localizable.xcstrings.

name: Convert SVG to PNG
summary: Renders an SVG vector graphic into a raster PNG image file at a specified scale or dimensions.

name: Swift AST Inspector
summary: Inspects the abstract syntax tree (AST) and type declaration hierarchy of a Swift source file.

name: Swift Concurrency Analyzer
summary: Audits Swift code for Swift 6 strict concurrency hazards, mutable globals, and actor isolation boundaries.

name: SwiftData Schema Auditor
summary: Audits SwiftData models (@Model), attributes, relationships, and migration schemas across the workspace.

name: Swift Format Linter
summary: Lints Swift source files for code style, line length, indentation, and formatting violations.

name: Swift 6 Migration Advisor
summary: Audits Swift code for Swift 6 strict concurrency compliance, mutable globals, actor boundaries, and Sendable conformance.

name: Swift Package Manager
summary: Inspects, resolves, updates, and validates Swift Package Manager (SPM) dependencies.

name: Move Symbol Across Files
summary: Moves a top-level Swift declaration from a source file to a destination file by extracting its brace-balanced block, removing it from the source, and appending it to the destination. Verifies the symbol is present in the destination and its declaration is gone from the source, restoring both files on verification failure. Brace matching is heuristic and does not parse strings or comments.

name: Symbol Reference Graph
summary: Traverses workspace files to identify declarations, references, and call sites for a given Swift symbol.

name: Rename Symbol Project-Wide
summary: Renames a symbol across Swift files by replacing whole-word occurrences of oldName with newName. Only files that actually change are rewritten. Refuses when oldName equals newName or either name is not a valid Swift identifier.

name: Symlink Audit
summary: Finds symbolic links under a directory, reporting each target and flagging broken links.

name: Post macOS System Notification
summary: Posts a genuine macOS system notification banner or alert with custom title, subtitle, sound, and message body for build status, task completions, or developer alerts.

name: take_screenrecord
summary: Records the screen of a specifically identified application, subject to macOS privacy permissions and recording restrictions, and produces a usable recording artifact.

name: take_screenshot
summary: Captures the user's entire screen or a user-selected screen region, produces a valid PNG image, and makes the resulting image available to the active AI model for visual analysis.

name: Create Tar Archive
summary: Creates a .tar or .tar.gz archive from a directory or files using system tar.

name: Extract Tar Archive
summary: Extracts a .tar or .tar.gz archive into a destination directory using system tar.

name: Target Dependencies List
summary: Lists Xcode target-to-target dependencies parsed from the project's .pbxproj.

name: Target Source List
summary: Lists the source files compiled into a given Xcode target (Compile Sources build phase), resolved from the .pbxproj.

name: Run Task
summary: Executes a registered internal Swift task within the sandbox.

name: Test Coverage Report
summary: Runs xcodebuild test with code coverage enabled and reports the coverage summary plus pass/fail.

name: Test Coverage Reporter
summary: Extracts line and target test coverage metrics from build and test artifacts via xccov.

name: Test Data Factory
summary: Writes a test fixture file: a JSON object with sample values per field type, or a Swift struct with a static sample.

name: Flaky Test Detection
summary: Parses test logs and reports tests that show both pass and fail outcomes across runs.

name: Parse Test Log
summary: Parses a test log for passed/failed test cases, suite summaries, and errors, returning counts plus the failed test list.

name: Run Single Test
summary: Runs one test by ID with xcodebuild test -only-testing and returns pass/fail plus the output tail.

name: Manage Test Snapshots
summary: Lists snapshot test reference images under __Snapshots__ directories, or deletes unreferenced snapshot files when confirm is true.

name: Add Test Target
summary: Creates a test directory with a real XCTest file and inserts a PBXNativeTarget block into the project pbxproj.

name: TODO & FIXME Scanner
summary: Scans workspace files to index all TODO, FIXME, MARK, HACK, and BUG annotations.

name: TODO Scan
summary: Scans Swift source files for TODO, FIXME, XXX, and HACK markers and returns a file:line:text list with counts per tag.

name: Tool Capability Lookup
summary: Looks up a registered tool's capability, risk level, description, and parameter schema from the live registry.

name: Tree View
summary: Generates a tree-like representation of the project structure.

name: Type Hierarchy
summary: Maps class/struct/enum/protocol declarations and their inheritance and conformance clauses across Swift sources.

name: UI Test Scaffold
summary: Creates a real XCTest UI test file with setUp, launch, a launch-state assertion, and tearDown.

name: Unused Imports Detector
summary: Scans Swift files to detect redundant or unused framework imports.

name: Unzip Archive
summary: Extracts a .zip archive into a destination directory using the macOS system archive tool.

name: use_app
summary: Enables Assist to operate native macOS applications through real Accessibility APIs, CoreGraphics synthetic events, ScreenCaptureKit visual perception, and window management.

name: Execute Composio Tool
summary: Execute external connected tools (GitHub, Slack, Google Calendar, Jira, Linear, Gmail, etc.) via Composio Platform or CLI.

name: Use Extension
summary: Interact with installed SwiftCode extensions: list, inspect, activate, and execute VS Code extension commands through the real extension host, and run Xcode-compatible source-editor commands against real workspace files. Actions: list, details, list_commands, list_xcode_commands, activate, deactivate, execute, run_xcode_command, enable, disable, diagnostics. Mutating actions (activate, execute, run_xcode_command, enable, disable) require confirm: true. Extension ids are stable publisher.name ids; Xcode command ids look like com.swiftcode.xcode.sortLines.

name: Execute MCP Tool
summary: Enumerate configured MCP servers, discover capabilities, and execute external tools (e.g. GitHub, databases, developer services). Pass toolName: 'list_tools' to discover available tools.

name: System Diagnostics
summary: macOS system diagnostics and one authorized user-level configuration op. Diagnostics: system_info, dev_environment, process_list, network_interfaces, listening_sockets, connectivity, disk_info, system_log, service_status, config_read (sysctl allowlist). Mutation: user_defaults_write (requires confirm: true; verified by read-back). Fixed-argv subprocesses only; privileged actions are refused, never escalated.

name: Use Terminal
summary: Executes terminal commands on the user's machine. Commands on the user's allow-list (Assist Settings > Terminal Command Approvals), or any command when Full Access is enabled, run without an approval prompt; all other commands require explicit user approval.

name: Version Control Operator
summary: Performs branch, commit, rollback, and diff operations using git.

name: View Memory
summary: Reads and retrieves stored context, preferences, and architectural decisions from UserMemory.md.

name: Workspace Settings Read
summary: Reads Xcode workspace/shared settings (.xcsettings plists): build system, derived-data location, and IDE workspace checks.

name: Xcode Build Settings Inspector
summary: Inspects and extracts active build configuration settings, flags, and paths via xcodebuild.

name: Xcode Device Destination Finder
summary: Lists connected physical Apple devices and available simulator runtimes for building and testing.

name: Xcode Scheme & Build Configuration Manager
summary: Inspects, lists, and queries Xcode schemes, targets, and build configurations in the workspace.

name: Xcode Toolchain Info
summary: Reports the active Xcode version, build number, and installed SDKs via xcodebuild.

name: XCResult Bundle Parser
summary: Locates and parses .xcresult bundles to extract test failures, warnings, and compilation diagnostics.

name: XCTest Discovery
summary: Discovers XCTestCase subclasses and their test methods across the workspace — a test inventory without running anything.

name: YAML Parser & Validator
summary: Validates structure and syntax of YAML files (workflows, project.yml, fastlane) in the workspace.

name: Validate YAML
summary: Heuristic YAML validation (no full YAML parser): rejects tab indentation, unbalanced brackets/quotes, duplicate top-level keys, and mapping lines without a colon. Format normalizes indentation to 2 spaces per level and only writes back when write is true and validation passes.

name: Zip File or Directory
summary: Compresses a file or directory into a .zip archive using the macOS system archive tool.
